worldcombat.skill.astonish.summary: A startled scream with no warning: an instant, point-blank interrupt with a 0-tick wind-up. The damage is light, but the target almost always flinches - and the darker it is, the harder it hits, flinches and lasts.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.description.0: The scream deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block startle radius; it is stronger in the dark. The target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.description.2: A point-blank scream has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s; both are higher in the dark.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.lurk.on: Lurking form: stays put and barely closes in, but flinches longer and more often at lighter damage, with a slower recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.lurk.off: Quick call: creeps in a little, snappy to cast and hits slightly harder.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s (instant), recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.growth.0: From level %1$s the shriek power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.growth.1: From level %1$s the shriek power rises to %2$s, the flinch chance to %3$s and its duration to %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.use.0: Interrupt a point-blank target with an instant scream
worldcombat.skill.astonish.use.1: Flinch a target for longer in the dark
worldcombat.skill.astonish.use.2: Open a combo at almost no cost
worldcombat.skill.astonish.preference.lu: On: stays put and barely closes in, but flinches longer and more often at lighter damage and with a slower recovery and cooldown; good for controlling a target from the dark. Off: a quick call - creeps in a little, snappy to cast and slightly harder.
worldcombat.skill.astonish.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The scream is nearly point-blank; too large only makes the companion run for nothing.
Always: treat it as a point-blank interrupt, usable at any time. Dark only: scream only when the user stands in block light below 7; stronger in the dark, but almost never used in the light.
